items:
Welcome to Sail Away Villa Lago—your luxury Sandestin retreat where adventure awaits just steps away. Overlooking the Baytowne Golf Course, this stylish villa includes 2 golf carts, stream fishing in your backyard, and quick access to beach, bay, and Baytowne Wharf. Walk, bike, or cruise anywhere you need to go—no car required for the perfect coastal getaway!

🌟 Amenities You’ll Love 🌟
🏖 Velvet-Soft Beaches – Quick golf cart ride to powdery white sand & turquoise Gulf waters of Sandestin/Miramar Beach
🚙 2 Golf Carts (4 & 6-Seater) – Explore the resort with easy access to the beach, pool & Baytowne Wharf
🐾 Pet-Friendly – Bring your furry family members along for the adventure
🎉 Baytowne Wharf Fun – Dining, shopping, fireworks, concerts & arcades just minutes away
⛳ Golfer’s Paradise – Play 3 championship courses right inside the resort
🏓 Stay Active – Pickleball, tennis & basketball courts right in the resort
🏊 Heated Pool – Phil Hummel pool open year-round for swimming & relaxation
💪 Fitness & Wellness – Spa for ultimate relaxation + fully equipped gym (fee applies)
🔥 Cozy Evenings – Modern electric fireplace in the living room
🎮 Xbox in Bunk Room – Family fun with games included
🧺 Washer & Dryer – Convenient laundry access for longer stays

📍 Location Highlights
3 min - Sandestin Beach (by golf cart)
4 min – Baytowne Wharf (dining, shopping, entertainment & events)
4 min – Baytowne Adventure Zone
8 min – Grand Boulevard (restaurants, shops, cinema)
11 min – Silver Sands Premium Outlets
13 min – Commelfo Restaurant (upscale dining)
25 min – Henderson Beach State Park

Nestled in Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort, you’ll be surrounded by top attractions, championship golf, shopping and restaurants galore, and world-class beaches—all just a short golf cart ride away.

🏡 Your Space
🛏 Room for Everyone

Master King Suite – Second floor, private en-suite, private balcony, serene golf course views

Queen Suite – Second floor with its own en-suite

Bunk Room – Two bunk beds (sleeps 4) + hideaway twin - private en-suite + Xbox for endless fun

Main Floor King Bedroom – Convenient with full bath just across the hall

🛋 Relax in the Living Room
Unwind after a day of adventure in the cozy living area. Featuring a modern electric fireplace, two recliners, and a spacious sectional with sleeper sofa, it’s perfect for movie nights, game time, or simply kicking back together.

🌊 Streamside Serenity
Behind the home, a peaceful stream offers catch-and-release fishing and a soothing natural backdrop, adding privacy from the golf course.

🍴 Kitchen Ready for Every Meal
Cook with ease in the fully stocked kitchen with granite countertops, stainless appliances, and extras like a crockpot, griddle, blender, and roasting pan. Head to the back patio for steaks or fresh seafood on the propane grill while overlooking the fairway.

🍽 Dining Made Easy
Enjoy meals at the 9-person dining table, with additional seating for 3 at the breakfast bar. A high-chair and booster are provided so everyone has a seat.

☕ Morning Coffee, Your Way
Brew with a Keurig, drip maker, or grinder—perfect for sunrise coffee on the patio.

🚗 Getting Around Made Simple
Park your car and cruise in style! Two golf carts (4-seater & 6-seater) are included for quick access to the beach, bay, golf courses, Baytowne Wharf, pool, and Grand Boulevard.

🏖 Velvety-Soft Beaches Await
Just a short golf cart ride away, you’ll find Sandestin’s world-famous velvety-soft sandy beaches. Sink your toes in the white sand, swim in turquoise waters, or enjoy sunset strolls along the Gulf—true paradise.

⛳ A Golfer’s Paradise
Play on three championship golf courses right inside the resort—The Links, Baytowne Golf Club, and Raven Golf Club. Additional top-tier courses are just a short drive away, making Sandestin a dream for every golfer.

🏓 Endless Amenities in Sandestin
Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort keeps everyone entertained:
Pickleball, tennis & basketball courts
The Phil Hummel heated pool (open year-round)
Villa Lago pool (walking distance from the house)
A relaxing spa to unwind
A fully equipped workout gym (fee applies)
Year-round family-friendly events

🎉 Excitement at Baytowne Wharf
A short golf cart ride takes you to Baytowne Wharf, a lively hub of restaurants, shops, and activities. From fireworks and live music to arcades and movie nights under the stars, there’s always something happening. The walking piers overlooking the water are absolute musts!

At Sail Away Villa Lago, every detail is designed to make your Sandestin stay unforgettable. Whether you’re sipping morning coffee by the stream, cruising to the beach in your golf cart, playing a round of golf, or enjoying evenings at Baytowne Wharf, this home is the perfect blend of relaxation, fun, and convenience. Pet-friendly and packed with resort amenities, it’s an ideal retreat for families, golfers, and groups looking to create lasting memories on the Emerald Coast. 🌴✨
You must be 25 years old with a valid drivers license to drive the golf cart. Please carry your drivers license and insurance card with you when driving the golf cart as golf cart rules coincide with DMV street laws.
